description: The reference answer for every (candidate, requirement) pair, written by reading the CV text against the requirement and before running the pipeline. `layer` records which part of the system ought to settle the pair: DETERMINISTIC means ordinary code has enough to decide it, SEMANTIC means only a reader can. Disagreement on `layer` is as interesting as disagreement on `verdict` — code deciding a pair it should have left alone is the costliest error this system can make, because it produces a confident verdict with evidence attached.
